attach_file.description: Loads one file into context by persistent ID or a path relative to an attached folder.
rules: With one attached folder, use a relative path (filename.txt or src/main.py). With multiple folders, prefix folder_id/. Persistent file IDs still work. Optional #Lstart-Lend selects inclusive lines (default 200, max 400; 24000 characters; UTF-8 up to 1 MiB).
Loaded content appears once in FILE_CONTENT. An already-loaded file fails; DETACH_FILE first to reread or change its range. Batch independent markers in one message.
